You are an information extraction system for card scheme pricing guides.

You will receive ONE text chunk from a PDF. Extract only billing events that the scheme charges to an acquirer or issuer. Ignore narrative text, footnotes, and cross-references to other sections.

For each billing event you find, return one object with these fields:
  fee_code        the alphanumeric identifier as printed
  fee_name        the official name, verbatim
  billed_party    acquirer | issuer
  region          the geography the fee applies to
  amount          the value as printed, including currency or percentage
  frequency       how often the scheme bills it
  effective_date  ISO 8601, or null if the chunk does not state one
  notes           any condition that changes the amount

If the chunk contains no billing event, return an empty list. Do not infer values that are not present in the text. Do not merge two fees into one entry.

messages.content:
--- PAGE 27 ---
2AB1006T    Authorization Acquirer Fee Domestic—Max
AA
The scheme bills the acquirer weekly for each authorization request submitted on a domestic transaction. The fee is capped at USD 0.0055 per request. Volumes above 120,000,000,000 annual authorizations qualify for the tiered schedule described in section 4.2.
Effective 1 October 2026.

--- PAGE 27 (cont) ---
2AB1007T    Authorization Acquirer Fee Cross-Border
AB
Billed monthly to the acquirer. USD 0.0000026 per authorization for the first 15,000,000,000 requests in the calendar year; thereafter the standard rate of USD 0.0041 applies. Chargebacks are excluded from the count.

messages.content:
--- PAGE 28 ---
2AB1012I    Issuer Digital Enablement Fee
DE
Charged to the issuer per token provisioned, at 0.15% of the first transaction value, minimum EUR 0.02 and maximum EUR 1.75. Billed quarterly. Tokens provisioned and deprovisioned within 30 days are not billed.
